item.content:encoded: Die populistische britische Partei Reform UK hat eine Spende in Höhe von vier Millionen Pfund von einem umstrittenen Krypto-Investor erhalten. Ben Delo, der in den USA wegen eines Verstoßes gegen das Bankgeheimnis verurteilt und von Donald Trump begnadigt worden war, steuerte damit 75 Prozent der gesamten Parteispenden im vergangenen Quartal bei. Insgesamt nahm die von dem langjährigen Brexit-Vorkämpfer Nigel Farage geführte Partei von April bis Juni 5,3 Millionen Pfund an Spenden ein, wie aus am Donnerstag veröffentlichten Zahlen der Wahlbehörde hervorgeht. Reform UK teilte mit, man freue sich über die Unterstützung erfolgreicher britischer Unternehmer bei der Vorbereitung auf die nächste Parlamentswahl. Delo hatte angekündigt, sich in der Politik zu engagieren, um Großbritannien vor einem unumkehrbaren Niedergang zu bewahren. Der bisherige Hauptgeldgeber, der in Thailand lebende Krypto-Unternehmer Christopher Harborne, spendete in dem Quartal dagegen nichts. Die britische Regierung hatte in diesem Jahr Pläne angekündigt, die finanziellen Zuwendungen von im Ausland lebenden britischen Staatsbürgern auf 100.000 Pfund zu begrenzen. Nachdem zudem bekannt wurde, dass Harborne Farage im Jahr 2024 fünf Millionen Pfund zukommen ließ, die dieser nicht deklarierte, sank die Beliebtheit der Partei. Farage bestreitet jegliches Fehlverhalten und bezeichnet das Geld als persönliches Geschenk, das nicht meldepflichtig sei. Derzeit prüfen Parlamentsmitarbeiter, ob dies gegen die Transparenzregeln für Parteispenden verstößt. Falls ein Regelverstoß festgestellt wird, könnte Farage sein Mandat verlieren und müsste sich erneut zur Wahl stellen. Im Parlament verfügt Reform UK nur über acht Abgeordnete. Dennoch führte die Partei die Umfragen in Großbritannien in den vergangenen zwei Jahren zumeist an. Dies änderte sich jedoch mit dem Rücktritt von Premierminister Keir Starmer und seiner Ablösung durch Andy Burnham im Juli, was der regierenden Labour-Partei neuen Auftrieb gab. Labour nahm im abgelaufenen Quartal ohne öffentliche Mittel 3,6 Millionen Pfund an Spenden ein. Die oppositionellen Konservativen kamen auf 2,8 Millionen Pfund.

item.title: Syria begins destroying Assad-era chemical weapons
item.description: Syria has begun destroying the remnants of a clandestine Assad-era chemical weapons program that it recovered in May, the first such destruction in a decade, a Syrian envoy and a U.N. representative said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Syria has begun destroying the remnants of a clandestine Assad-era chemical weapons program that it recovered in May, the first such destruction in a decade, a Syrian envoy and a U.N. representative said on Thursday. Reuters reported in May that Syria's new leadership had [USN:L6N4230RI TEXT:"located remnants"] of former Syrian President Bashar al-Assad's chemical weapons program, including raw materials and munitions similar to those used in deadly gas attacks during the country's civil war. Izumi Nakamitsu, the United Nations High Representative for Disarmament Affairs, told a Security Council briefing on Thursday that for the first time since 2014, the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons had verified the destruction of chemical munitions in Syria. Following the May finding, Syria had found "one additional chemical weapons production facility, a newly discovered chemical used in the production of nerve agents, and empty chemical munitions. It also declared two chemical weapons storage facilities where the newly discovered facilities were being stored," Nakamitsu said. Last month, the OPCW deployed a team to Syria to verify the destruction of category three chemical weapons, referring to unfilled munitions and other equipment used to release chemical weapons. She said the team verified "the irreversible destruction of 42 aerial bombs" as part of that mission. Syria's ambassador to the U.N., Ibrahim Olabi, told the council that Syria was "protecting the world and the region through such work". But he heavily criticised Israel, saying that repeated Israeli attacks had impeded some search and destruction operations, and exposed the Syrian teams at work to risk. "We cannot safeguard the security of the region if our security is exposed to attacks at the hands of Israel, and they are flouting the security of the region at large and they are breaching the conventions and treaties we have talked about," said Olabi, whose Arabic remarks were translated at the council. The Israeli military did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Olabi said Syria was preparing to hold the first court hearing of people suspected of involvement in the chemical weapons programme. Syrian authorities earlier this year took 18 suspects into custody for alleged involvement in Assad's chemical weapons program, including high-level military, political and technical officials.

item.title: Only democratic government can provide stability for oil investors, Venezuelan opposition leader says
item.description: Only a "serious, democratic government" can provide the stability needed by investors in Venezuela's oil sector, opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado said in a video message on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Only a "serious, democratic government" can provide the stability needed by investors in Venezuela's oil sector, opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado said in a video message on Thursday. International energy firms on Wednesday committed to expanding projects in the country in a signing ceremony overseen by interim President Delcy Rodriguez and [USN:L6N44U118 TEXT:"U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright"]. [USN:L1N44U0I0 TEXT:"The signings"], including by Eni, GE Vernova and Chevron, represent the latest effort by private companies to help revive Venezuela's struggling oil industry, which produces about 1.25 million barrels per day, far short of its 3 million bpd peak in the late 1990s. The deals are separate from a Caracas-Washington deal that gives the U.S. access to 17 oilfields. "The United States is the principal partner Venezuela needs to fully develop its strategic potential," Machado said in a video posted to X. "The enemies of the United States in Venezuela are sitting in Miraflores (presidential palace) today. And precisely because the partnership between Venezuela and the United States is strategic for both countries, we all need to make sure this is done right. "We need to attract capital and sustained, long-term investment under conditions that provide profitability, certainty and security, while delivering a real reduction in Venezuela’s country risk," she added. "That is only possible with the legitimacy and stability provided by a serious, democratic government." Machado, who has been outside Venezuela since late last year, when she left after living in hiding in order to receive her Nobel, has taken pains for years to develop close ties with the Trump administration, which removed Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in a January raid. His former vice president Rodriguez has been at a helm since. U.S. officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who has historically been close with Machado, have this week [USN:L6N44T12B TEXT:"defended Washington's oil deal"], casting it as part of a process to align Venezuela's energy industry with the U.S. while helping rebuild a nation ravaged by corruption, and said that the time is still not right for elections. Machado said the "true scope" of the deal was unclear, including who was signing it, what guarantees were being provided and what benefits it would bring for Venezuelans. International observers have criticized the official results of a 2024 presidential election, which Machado's political movement says it won by a landslide. Venezuela's electoral authorities and top court said Maduro had won.

item.title: Rendimiento de bonos EEUU cae tras comentarios de Waller de Fed y nuevos datos económicos
item.description: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense caía el jueves, prolongando su tendencia a la baja tras comentarios del gobernador de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller que apuntaban a una disposición a mantener las tasas de interés, mientras que nuevos datos económicos indicaron que el mercado laboral sigue estable.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
item.content:encoded: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense caía el jueves, prolongando su tendencia a la baja tras comentarios del gobernador de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller que apuntaban a una disposición a mantener las tasas de interés, mientras que nuevos datos económicos indicaron que el mercado laboral sigue estable. * Waller afirmó en unas declaraciones preparadas para un evento de Reuters NEXT Newsmaker celebrado en Washington que, si los próximos datos confirman que las presiones inflacionarias se están moderando, se inclinaría por mantener las tasas sin cambios en la próxima reunión de política monetaria del banco central estadounidense. * El rendimiento de los bonos referenciales a 10 años caía 3,6 puntos básicos, al 4,758%, en camino a su mayor descenso desde el 25 de agosto, tras tocar en la víspera el 4,818%, su nivel más alto desde el 1 de noviembre de 2023. El de las notas a 30 años restaba 2,4 puntos básicos, al 5,243%. * Los retornos se dispararon esta semana en todo el mundo, en parte debido a las preocupaciones por la inflación provocadas por el aumento de los precios del petróleo tras el reinicio de las hostilidades entre Estados Unidos e Irán. Los comentarios de algunas autoridades de la Fed a favor de una subida de tasas también contribuyeron. * "Creemos que el mercado se ha precipitado", dijo Jay Hatfield, de Infrastructure Capital Advisors en Nueva York. "Los datos apuntarían a un recorte, pero, por supuesto, la inflación general es terrible. Ahora el contrato de diciembre cobra mayor relevancia y sigue habiendo expectativas de subidas de tasas, aunque los datos no lo respaldan". * En el ámbito económico, las solicitudes iniciales de subsidio por desempleo semanales aumentaron en 2.000, a una cifra desestacionalizada de 206.000, algo por sobre de la estimación de 205.000 realizada por los economistas sondeados por Reuters. * El retorno de los papeles a dos años, que suele evolucionar en consonancia con las expectativas sobre tasas de la Fed, perdía 5,2 puntos básicos, al 4,334%, tras subir el miércoles al 4,41%, su máximo desde enero de 2025. * Una parte muy seguida de la curva de rendimiento, que mide la diferencia entre el retorno de la deuda a dos y 10 años y se considera un indicador de las expectativas económicas, operaba a 42,2 puntos básicos.

item.title: Kaia stars as Zimbabwe win by five wickets
item.description: Zimbabwe beat hosts Namibia by five wickets on Thursday to keep alive hopes of reaching the weekend final of the Twenty20 tri-series also involving South Africa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Zimbabwe beat hosts Namibia by five wickets on Thursday to keep alive hopes of reaching the weekend final of the Twenty20 tri-series also involving South Africa. Innocent Kaia scored a T20 career-best 72 off 42 balls to help chase down the target with 11 balls to spare at the Namibia Cricket Ground. Namibia were put into bat and captain Gerhard Erasmus hit an unbeaten 88 off 48 balls as they scored 156-6 in their 20 overs but Zimbabwe had little trouble chasing down the total as Kaia led the way with support from captain Sikandar Raza, who scored 29, as they amassed 159 for five. Zimbabwe won both their games against Namibia but lost twice to South Africa, who are playing Namibia in the last round-robin match on Friday. South Africa have a 2-1 record and Namibia 1-2 after three matches each. The top two teams play a final on Sunday.

item.title: EEUU reclamará a Europa el pago retroactivo de la ayuda a Ucrania: Trump
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el jueves que pedirá a los países europeos que reembolsen a Estados Unidos la ayuda militar y las municiones enviadas previamente a Ucrania, y pareció insinuar que se suspenderían las ventas a los países aliados.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el jueves que pedirá a los países europeos que reembolsen a Estados Unidos la ayuda militar y las municiones enviadas previamente a Ucrania, y pareció insinuar que se suspenderían las ventas a los países aliados. En una publicación en las redes sociales, Trump también criticó duramente los informes que apuntan a que las reservas de munición de Estados Unidos se habían reducido considerablemente debido a la guerra en Irán, al tiempo que añadió que el país está acumulando munición. "Las estamos reservando para nosotros, EEUU, en lugar de venderlas a otros, pero las ventas a los aliados se reanudarán pronto", escribió Trump. "Se entregaron cientos de miles de millones de dólares a Ucrania y a la OTAN, de forma gratuita, que Europa habría pagado —si se les hubiera pedido—, ¡pero vamos a pedir ese dinero, aunque sea con algo de retraso!", añadió. Reuters informó el mes pasado de que el Ejército estadounidense ha agotado gran parte de sus reservas de misiles de largo alcance de alta precisión durante la guerra con Irán, lo que ha suscitado preocupación sobre la preparación de las Fuerzas Armadas para futuros conflictos.

item.title: Is the world worried about the wrong debt?
item.description: Hi there. Carmel is away this week, so I’m filling in for her and wanted to discuss a debt issue that may be flying under the radar for some.
item.dc:creator: Balazs Koranyi
item.content:encoded: Hi there. Carmel is away this week, so I’m filling in for her and wanted to discuss a debt issue that may be flying under the radar for some. All the market talk has been [USN:L4N44S076 TEXT:"focused on U.S. debt"] hitting $40 trillion this summer, with interest costs rising to over $1 trillion a year as the 10-year yield inches towards 5%. Sure, the U.S. is on an unsustainable path and the [USN:FWN44G0QP TEXT:"Treasury’s efforts to bring down"] longer-term borrowing costs are likely to prove futile without meaningful fiscal correction. But the U.S. enjoys the exorbitant privilege of issuing the world’s reserve currency in the deepest bond market. Capital keeps flowing in and economic growth remains stellar, driven by massive AI investments. So its debt market may be creaking, but it’s certainly not breaking just yet. France, the euro zone’s second-biggest economy, may be in a far more precarious position, however. At 117% of GDP, it has one of the highest debt levels in the developed world and is heading into a tense presidential election in which the frontrunners are [USN:L8N44I0JF TEXT:"hard-left and far-right candidates"] both pushing expensive platforms. And French governments already have a long history of retreating from reforms in the face of street protests and political pressure. This lack of economic transformation has left growth below 1%, which makes it essentially impossible for the country to grow out of its debt. Spending meanwhile remains unsustainably high and the [USN:L8N44H1DA TEXT:"budget deficit"] will again exceed the target this year. Reflecting those troubles, the 10-year French yield, a key gauge of perceived financial health, has risen to around 4.25% this summer, almost double the central bank interest rate. The regional implications of any capital flight could be massive. Italy, Spain and Belgium all have debt levels in excess of 100% of GDP, so the risk of contagion and turbulence is high. That would then put pressure on the only entity that could restore calm to the euro zone bond market: the European Central Bank. The ECB has the firepower to calm markets but has so far gone out of its way not to use it. It has spent years reducing its government bond holdings and set tough conditions for any market intervention. Its Transmission Protection Instrument could be used to hoover up debt and push yields back down, but only in case of “unwarranted” market moves. It is hard to argue that a rise in yields for an indebted country with weak economic fundamentals amid political turmoil is not warranted. France is too big to fail, however, and the ECB could come under pressure to intervene, even if the legal justifications could be questionable. The spread between 10-year German and French debt, a key indicator of investors’ risk appetite, has been inching up all summer and stands at 87 basis points, above that for Italy and its highest level in years. While it is not yet in the danger zone, it’s clearly moving in the wrong direction, and it may be just a matter of time before the ECB’s resolve is tested again. item.title: Report: Boston College extends contract of AD Blake James
item.description: Boston College athletic director Blake James has been given a contract extension through 2031, ESPN reported Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Boston College athletic director Blake James has been given a contract extension through 2031, ESPN reported Thursday. James has been at Boston College since July 2022 after more than 11 years at Miami (Fla.), the final nine of them as athletic director. He also was the AD at Maine from 2005-10. He has extensive experience in NCAA circles. He is serving a four-year term as a member of the NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Committee and previously served on the NCAA Board of Directors (2017-19) and the NCAA Football Oversight Committee (2015-17). Blake also previously chaired the NCAA Division I Council, which made the day-to-day decision for Division I athletics. He was hired to replace former AD Pat Kraft, who left the job at Boston College to become the athletic director at Penn State. --Field Level Media

item.title: Canada invests C$4.7 billion to build VIA Rail cars domestically
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Thursday that his government will invest C$4.7 billion ($3.41 billion) to build and maintain VIA Rail passenger cars in Canada, marking the first time in four decades that the rail company's cars will be built domestically.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Thursday that his government will invest C$4.7 billion ($3.41 billion) to build and maintain VIA Rail passenger cars in Canada , marking the first time in four decades that the rail company's cars will be built domestically. "For the first time in four decades, VIA's passenger cars will be produced and assembled in Canada. Cars that used to be built in the United States will be built right here in Thunder Bay at Alstom Canada," Carney said at a news conference in Thunder Bay, Ontario. Carney said the investment would build 313 new-generation passenger cars and support nearly 700 jobs in Ontario and Quebec. The announcement comes amid a [USN:SPN44J009 TEXT:"worsening trade war"] with the U.S. Canadian retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. annual imports are set to come into effect on September 8, in response to tariffs levied against Canada last month by U.S. President Donald Trump , affecting $20 billion of Canadian imports. Carney said his government was ready to sit down and strike a trade deal with the U.S. when Washington is ready, but "there must be stability and credibility" in any such agreement. ($1 = 1.3801 Canadian dollars)

item.title: Reform UK plans investor roadshow to build confidence in its economic approach
item.description: Robert Jenrick, Reform UK's economy policy chief, said on Thursday he planned a roadshow to meet investors in London and New York to set out the party's economic plans and build confidence in its ability to manage Britain's public finances.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Robert Jenrick, Reform UK's economy policy chief, said on Thursday he planned a roadshow to meet investors in London and New York to set out the party's economic plans and build confidence in its ability to manage Britain's public finances. On the first day of Reform's annual party conference, Jenrick said he wanted to explain the anti-immigration party's plans for deep spending cuts, including cutting £50 billion from welfare spending, arguing that credibility with investors would be crucial to reducing the government's financing costs. "The aim will be to explain, to answer questions, to listen and to instil confidence," he said. "If we come into government, we can then bring down the cost of borrowing. I don't think it will happen overnight, but I hope it will happen over a period of time as we win the trust of the markets." Reform, led by Brexit campaigner Nigel Farage, has surged in popularity since the 2024 election, but has never run the central government, meaning it must convince investors and businesses that it is capable of governing responsibly. British government bond yields hit their highest levels since the global financial crisis this week, adding to the challenges facing finance minister John Healey ahead of his first budget next month.

item.title: Las hermanas Mara hablan al unísono en la película de Herzog que compite en Venecia
item.description: Las hermanas Rooney y Kate Mara afirmaron que los años de experiencias compartidas les ayudaron a superar un reto interpretativo único: hablar al unísono en la película "Bucking fastard", de Werner Herzog, que se estrenó el jueves en el Festival de Cine de Venecia.
item.dc:creator: Kristian Brunse
item.content:encoded: Las hermanas Rooney y Kate Mara afirmaron que los años de experiencias compartidas les ayudaron a superar un reto interpretativo único: hablar al unísono en la película "Bucking fastard", de Werner Herzog, que se estrenó el jueves en el Festival de Cine de Venecia. En la película, inspirada en unas gemelas británicas de la vida real, las hermanas Mara interpretan a Jean y Joan Holbrooke, cuya extraordinaria cercanía hace que hablen en perfecta sincronía, compartan los mismos sueños y se enamoren del mismo hombre. Es la primera vez que ambas actúan juntas en la gran pantalla. "Teníamos programadas dos semanas de ensayos, pero Kate y yo nos juntamos antes porque estábamos bastante nerviosas", explicó Rooney Mara a Reuters. No obstante, Herzog afirmó que quedó tan impresionado por lo que vio que redujo el periodo de ensayos a solo cinco días. "Les dije: 'Ya basta. Estoy totalmente convencido de que va a quedar maravilloso. Dejen de ensayar, cállense, nos vemos en Irlanda delante de mi cámara'", explicó a Reuters. "Lo que están haciendo no tiene precedentes. No hemos visto nada parecido en la historia del cine, y dudo que volvamos a ver algo así en un futuro previsible". Rooney Mara, conocida sobre todo por sus papeles en "La red social" y "La chica del dragón tatuado", afirmó que todo el tiempo que pasaron juntas les permitió a las hermanas desarrollar una complicidad instantánea que encajó a la perfección en cuanto empezaron a rodar. "Había un mundo tácito entre nosotras que no nos costó nada crear. Nunca me había reído tanto; fue una experiencia única, de esas que solo se viven una vez en la vida", comentó. Kate Mara, cuya filmografía incluye "House of Cards" y "24", afirmó que hablar sincronizadas "era casi como cantar una canción". La película muestra cómo las dos hermanas se enamoran del mismo hombre, interpretado por Orlando Bloom. Cuando él las deja por otra mujer, tiene que solicitar una orden de alejamiento para protegerse de su furia. Bloom dijo a Reuters que fue una experiencia increíble actuar junto a sus compañeras de reparto. "Era casi como si respiraran juntas, soñaran juntas, amaran juntas, pensaran juntas. La película parece un poema, y ellas eran el centro de atención que nos dejaba boquiabiertos", señaló. Herzog no es ningún desconocido en Venecia. El aclamado director alemán, entre cuyas películas se encuentran "Aguirre, la cólera de Dios", "Fitzcarraldo" y "Grizzly Man2, estrenó "Grito de piedra" en el festival en 1991 y ha vuelto varias veces desde entonces tanto con largometrajes de ficción como con documentales. "Bucking fastard" es una de las 21 películas que compiten por el León de Oro de Venecia, que se entregará el 12 de septiembre.

item.title: India's Cipla, China's Qilu partner for US launch of Merck's Keytruda biosimilar
item.description: India's Cipla said on Thursday its U.S. unit entered an exclusive partnership with China's Qilu Pharmaceutical to license a biosimilar version of Merck's cancer drug Keytruda for the U.S. market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's Cipla (CIPL.NS) said on Thursday its U.S. unit entered an exclusive partnership with China's Qilu Pharmaceutical to license a biosimilar version of Merck's (MRK.N) cancer drug Keytruda for the U.S. market. Here are more details: Under the agreement, Qilu will handle development, regulatory approvals, manufacturing and supply of QL2107, a biosimilar version of Merck's Keytruda, while Cipla USA will be responsible for commercialization and sales in the United States. QL2107 was developed to offer patients a more affordable treatment option that matches the original cancer therapy's safety and efficacy profile. Cipla said the agreement supports its strategy to expand its oncology-focused biosimilars portfolio, leveraging Qilu's research and manufacturing capabilities and Cipla's U.S. commercial network. Keytruda, until recently the world's top-selling drug, is used against 20 different kinds of cancerous tumors and 45 types and stages of cancer. Merck is set to lose patent protection for Keytruda in [USN:L1N44N0PO TEXT:"2028"].

item.title: Azorra vê melhora em problemas de motor e forte demanda por jatos regionais
item.description: A empresa de leasing de aeronaves Azorra vê sinais de que os problemas nos motores da Pratt & Whitney estão diminuindo e espera que a forte demanda por jatos menores e mais eficientes em consumo de combustível continue, apesar das turbulências no setor e dos custos mais elevados de combustível.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Araujo
item.content:encoded: A empresa de leasing de aeronaves Azorra vê sinais de que os problemas nos motores da Pratt & Whitney estão diminuindo e espera que a forte demanda por jatos menores e mais eficientes em consumo de combustível continue, apesar das turbulências no setor e dos custos mais elevados de combustível. A Pratt & Whitney, unidade da RTX (RTX.N) , passou os últimos anos lidando com atrasos em manutenção e problemas de contaminação de metais que contribuíram para uma crise na indústria relacionada à escassez de motores e deixaram centenas de aeronaves paradas. Os motores turbofan GTF da Pratt equipam a família E2, da Embraer (EMBJ3.SA) , e os modelos A220 e A320neo, da Airbus (AIR.PA) . A Pratt afirmou em julho que as interrupções relacionadas à manutenção haviam diminuído e praticamente desaparecido para os modelos menores A220 e E2. No entanto, fontes da indústria disseram que a empresa ainda diverge da Airbus sobre o impacto dos problemas nos motores dos jatos maiores A320neo. "Acreditamos que a Pratt realmente melhorou", disse à Reuters o presidente da Azorra, Ron Baur, na quarta-feira, durante um evento que marcou a entrega do 2.000º E-Jet da Embraer. "Definitivamente, vemos uma luz no fim do túnel em relação aos motores." Baur afirmou que os problemas são comparáveis às "dores de crescimento" frequentemente observadas em novas tecnologias aeronáuticas, acrescentando que fabricantes de aeronaves e motores normalmente conseguem superar esses desafios ao longo do tempo. CRISE ADMINISTRÁVEL As companhias aéreas globais vêm enfrentando preços mais altos dos combustíveis desde que os ataques dos Estados Unidos e de Israel ao Irã interromperam o tráfego no Estreito de Ormuz. Ainda assim, Baur afirmou que a crise é "administrável" e não enfraqueceu de forma significativa a demanda por aeronaves. "A incerteza sempre desacelera as decisões sobre frotas, e vemos um pouco disso. Mas, na maior parte, continuamos observando uma demanda muito forte por aeronaves", disse ele, observando que as companhias aéreas têm conseguido repassar parte do aumento dos custos de combustível aos passageiros. Ele acrescentou que a escassez global de aeronaves continua sustentando a demanda por leasing, especialmente de jatos menores, como o E2 e o A220, que transportam até cerca de 150 passageiros e consomem menos combustível do que modelos mais antigos e maiores. A família E2 vendeu três vezes mais aeronaves do que o A220 no ano passado, embora a Airbus tenha conquistado recentemente uma grande encomenda da AirAsia. A Azorra possui compromissos de compra para ambas as famílias de aeronaves. "Acho que ambos são aviões muito bons. Sem dúvida, a Embraer teve um ano muito forte no ano passado. Esperamos que isso continue", disse Baur. O executivo também reiterou o interesse em uma possível versão alongada do A220, que a Airbus já estudou, mas ainda não lançou. "Acho que uma versão alongada, o A220-500, seria muito competitiva", afirmou. (Reportagem de Gabriel Araujo)

item.title: Fund von Werkzeug - Airbus drosselt zeitweise A330-Auslieferung
item.description: Airbus hat die Auslieferungen seines Langstreckenflugzeugs A330neo nach dem Fund eines vergessenen Werkzeugs in einer Maschine gedrosselt. Die Ursache sei inzwischen gefunden und die Auslieferungen wieder aufgenommen worden, teilte der Flugzeugbauer am Donnerstag mit. "Wir bestätigen, dass wir kürzlich ein vereinzeltes Qualitätsproblem an einem A330-Höhenleitwerk festgestellt haben", hieß es in einer per E-Mail versandten Erklärung. Dies habe zu Inspektionen bei in der Fertigung befindlichen A330 geführt. In der Folge seien die monatlichen Auslieferungen über den Sommer verlangsamt worden. Zuerst hatte die Nachrichtenagentur Bloomberg über die Qualitätsprobleme und die Verzögerungen berichtet.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Airbus (AIR.PA) hat die Auslieferungen seines Langstreckenflugzeugs A330neo nach dem Fund eines vergessenen Werkzeugs in einer Maschine gedrosselt. Die Ursache sei inzwischen gefunden und die Auslieferungen wieder aufgenommen worden, teilte der Flugzeugbauer am Donnerstag mit. "Wir bestätigen, dass wir kürzlich ein vereinzeltes Qualitätsproblem an einem A330-Höhenleitwerk festgestellt haben", hieß es in einer per E-Mail versandten Erklärung. Dies habe zu Inspektionen bei in der Fertigung befindlichen A330 geführt. In der Folge seien die monatlichen Auslieferungen über den Sommer verlangsamt worden. Zuerst hatte die Nachrichtenagentur Bloomberg über die Qualitätsprobleme und die Verzögerungen berichtet. Im Juni und Juli lieferte Airbus keine A330-Maschine aus. Im August wurde dann eine A330 dem Kunden übergeben. Insgesamt lieferte der Konzern in dem Monat 57 Flugzeuge aus, wie aus Airbus-Daten hervorgehen dürfte, die kommende Woche veröffentlicht werden sollen. Einer mit der Angelegenheit vertrauten Person zufolge wurde das Werkzeug bei einer Inspektion vor der Auslieferung im Inneren der Flugzeugstruktur entdeckt. Das Höhenleitwerk, das die Neigung der Flugzeugnase steuert, wird in den spanischen Airbus-Werken hergestellt. Der Fund stehe nicht im Zusammenhang mit den jüngsten Streiks in den spanischen Werken, sagte die Person weiter. Das Risiko von Schäden durch Fremdkörper (Foreign Object Damage, FOD) ist in der Luftfahrtindustrie ein bekanntes Problem. Dazu können bei der Produktion oder Wartung vergessene Gegenstände wie Werkzeuge oder auch Lappen gehören.

item.title: Everest adventure becomes story of loss in Venice festival documentary
item.description: A documentary about two elite mountaineers pursuing an apparently impossible dream became a study of grief and resilience after tragedy struck during production, its directors said at the Venice Film Festival on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Crispian Balmer
item.content:encoded: A documentary about two elite mountaineers pursuing an apparently impossible dream became a study of grief and resilience after tragedy struck during production, its directors said at the [USN:L8N4422FV TEXT:"Venice Film Festival"] on Thursday. "Everest: The Other Side" began as the story of ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson and their ambition to climb and ski down Everest's direct North Face, a forbidding route few climbers have ever completed and no one has skied. But the National Geographic documentary took a catastrophic turn after Nelson died in 2022 while skiing down Nepal's Mount Manaslu -- a scene captured on film. "It started as a love story between Jim and Hilaree and their dreams of climbing and skiing the Direct North Face. We never could have anticipated the tragedy that ensued," co-director Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi told reporters. UNPRECEDENTED MOUNTAIN VIEWS The film follows Morrison as he confronts the loss of his partner and decides whether to continue their dream alone. His journey is given added pathos by the fact his life was already scarred by tragedy, with his wife and their two young children dying in a 2011 plane crash. "For me, the film really looks at this question through Jim's eyes of how you can move through grief," Vasarhelyi said. "How do you learn to live with grief? How does that grief inform a life of intention?" Morrison said the mountains that had shaped his life also helped him cope with repeated personal losses. "I've suffered a lot of loss in my life and the mountains have provided a lot back to me," he said. "My craft is putting one foot in front of another and taking one day at a time." The film is directed by Vasarhelyi and Jimmy Chin, the Oscar-winning duo behind the climbing documentary "Free Solo". Chin, who accompanied Morrison on the Everest mission, said the new project sought not only to capture an unprecedented mountaineering feat but also the emotional and practical decisions made in one of Earth's most hostile environments. "No one's ever seen mountaineering like this," Vasarhelyi said, referring to footage shot on Everest's remote North Face. Chin described the challenge of filming an expedition where climbers and camera operators were operating at nearly 9,000 metres (29,500 ft). "The team was made up of world-class athletes and climbers who could also shoot," he said. "You have to be climbers first." The directors also highlighted the role of the Sherpa climbers who formed part of the expedition team, saying a new generation was increasingly pursuing its own ambitions rather than simply supporting Western expeditions. For Chin, however, the film's deeper message lies beyond mountaineering. "When you face your mortality on a fairly regular basis, it is about looking at your life through the lens of the inevitable," he said. "It can shape the way that you decide to live." The film is being shown out of competition at the Venice Film Festival, which runs until September 12.

item.title: Monedas suben por debilidad del dólar tras comentarios de Waller de la Fed
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina subían el jueves, en un escenario de retroceso del dólar en los mercados internacionales, que era presionado por comentarios del gobernador de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller, que dijo que podría respaldar el mantener las tasas de interés si los datos confirman que la presión sobre los precios se está moderando.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina subían el jueves, en un escenario de retroceso del dólar en los mercados internacionales, que era presionado por comentarios del gobernador de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller, que dijo que podría respaldar el mantener las tasas de interés si los datos confirman que la presión sobre los precios se está moderando. * Waller dijo el jueves que se inclina por mantener la paciencia en materia de política de tasas de interés, mientras observa si las presiones sobre los precios se moderan. * "Voy a parafrasear aquí a John Lennon: 'Démosle una oportunidad a la desinflación' y esperemos una reunión para ver cómo se presentan los datos", dijo Waller en un evento de Reuters NEXT en Washington. * Sus comentarios golpeaban al dólar ante sus principales cruces, lo que era amplificado, además, por la nueva fuerte alza del yen ante apuestas de alzas de tasas por parte del Banco de Japón. * A nivel de datos en Estados Unidos, el número de personas que solicitaron prestaciones por desempleo aumentó de forma leve la semana pasada, el crecimiento de la productividad laboral se aceleró en el segundo trimestre, el déficit comercial se amplió de forma considerable en julio y la actividad del sector servicios de Estados Unidos repuntó en agosto. * Los inversores, en tanto, aguardan los datos de nóminas no agrícolas de agosto -que se publicarán el viernes- para analizar el posible próximo movimiento en materia de tasas de interés por parte de la Fed en su reunión de mediados de septiembre. * El peso mexicano intentaba una recuperación, tras perder más temprano más de un 0,2%. y subía un 0,01%, a 16,9618 unidades por dólar; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, trepaba un 0,98%, a 65.520,26 puntos, apuntalado principalmente por las acciones de firmas mineras ante el alza de los precios de los metales. * El real brasileño perdía un 0,22%, a 5,1022 por dólar, luego de avanzar con fuerza en la sesión previa, al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) ganaba un 0,72%, a 186.530 puntos, ampliando sus avances tras dispararse en la víspera. * El peso colombiano se fortalecía un 0,49%, a 3.143,50 unidades por dólar, en su tercera jornada de apreciación, en tanto que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) repuntaba un 0,96%, a 2.513,19 puntos. * El peso chileno , subía un 0,43%, a 934,50/934,80 unidades por dólar, impulsado por el retroceso global del billete verde y un avance en los precios del cobre, la mayor exportación del país. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) cedía un 0,27%, a 11.525,19 puntos. * El peso mayorista argentino mostraba una leve mejora del 0,13% a 1.509 unidades por dólar, con el banco central (BCRA) interviniendo a diaria a favor de reforzar sus reservas internacionales. El índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires retrocedía un 0,28%. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreciaba un 0,12%, a 3,3590/3,3600 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) avanzaba apenas un 0,08%, a 1.573,62 puntos.

item.title: US to seek back payment from Europe for Ukraine aid, Trump says
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday said he would ask European nations to pay back the United States for military aid and munitions previously sent to Ukraine and appeared to signal a halt in sales to allied nations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday said he would ask European nations to pay back the United States for military aid and munitions previously sent to Ukraine and appeared to signal a halt in sales to allied nations. In a social media post, Trump also slammed reports of heavily depleted U.S. munition stockpiles amid the separate war in Iran, while adding that the United States was stockpiling munitions. "We are taking them for ourselves, the U.S.A., rather than selling them to others, but the sales to Allies will soon again, begin," Trump wrote. "Hundreds of Billions of Dollars was given to Ukraine and NATO, free of charge, that Europe would have paid for — If they were only asked, but we will be asking for that money, though somewhat belatedly!" he added. Reuters [USN:L1N43W1IH TEXT:"reported last month"] that the U.S. Army has used up much of its stockpile of highly accurate long-range missiles during the Iran war, raising concerns about the military's readiness for future conflicts.
