item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Bundesregierung hat einen Bericht der "Bild" zurückgewiesen, nach dem der Bund von seinem im Koalitionsvertrag vereinbarten Personalabbauziel abrückt. Im Gegenteil werde die Bundesregierung auch 2027 das Personal in Bundeseinrichtungen um zwei Prozent reduzieren, sagte ein Regierungssprecher der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters auf Anfrage. Davon seien aber ausdrücklich die Sicherheitsbehörden ausgenommen. Dort gibt es einen gewünschten Aufwuchs bei Bundeswehr, Zoll oder Bundespolizei um mehrere tausend Personen. Tatsächlich steht im schwarz-roten Koalitionsvertrag das Ziel: "Stellenabbau in der Bundesverwaltung um acht Prozent (zwei Prozent/Jahr) (Ausnahme für Sicherheitsbehörden)". Die "Bild" bezieht sich auf eine Studie der "Initiative Neue Soziale Marktwirtschaft"(INSM), in der es heißt, dass der Bund die Zahl der Stellen 2027 um 12.347 erhöhen wolle. "Die Zahl ist nicht aktuell und zudem irreführend, wenn sie in den Zusammenhang mit dem Einsparziel von acht Prozent gesetzt wird", sagte der Regierungssprecher. Dieses Ziel sei bewusst nicht für die sicherheitsrelevanten Planstellen gesetzt worden. "Der eigentliche Abbaupfad zu der vereinbarten Stelleneinsparung von acht Prozent sieht wie folgt aus: 2025 wurden 0,5 Prozent Personalabbau vereinbart und umgesetzt. Für 2026 wurde das Ziel von ursprünglich vereinbarten zwei Prozent auf 2,2 Prozent erhöht. Für 2027 und 2028 sind zwei Prozent und für 2029 1,5 Prozent vorgegeben." Die genauen Zahlen ließen sich zudem erst nennen, wenn das Haushaltsgesetz 2026 verabschiedet sei. Erst dann könnten die aktuellsten Daten berücksichtigt werden. Der Personalabbau im Bund zählt zu den zentralen Versprechen der Regierung neben dem Bürokratieabbau. Zugleich soll aber etwa die Bundeswehr um mehrere tausend Soldaten aufgestockt werden.

item.title: En el valle de Nepal, devastado por las inundaciones, no queda nada en pie
item.description: Desde el aire, el tramo del valle del río Trishuli, en Nepal, donde los equipos de rescate intentan llegar hasta los cientos de trabajadores atrapados en centrales hidroeléctricas, se presenta como una extensión gris y totalmente desolada.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Desde el aire, el tramo del valle del río Trishuli, en Nepal, donde los equipos de rescate intentan llegar hasta los cientos de trabajadores atrapados en centrales hidroeléctricas, se presenta como una extensión gris y totalmente desolada. Ocho días después del catastrófico alud, el suelo se ha endurecido como el hormigón o se ha convertido en una masa húmeda y resbaladiza, y no se vislumbra ningún indicio de asentamiento humano en amplias extensiones. Al llegar en helicóptero, el fotógrafo de Reuters Navesh Chitrakar vio cómo unas excavadoras intentaban retirar enormes rocas de la boca de un túnel en la central hidroeléctrica Upper Trishuli 3A. Sin embargo, la abertura era tan pequeña que los equipos de rescate nepalíes solo podían intentar entrar en el túnel arrastrándose por dentro. Las autoridades estiman que unas 900 personas se encuentran atrapadas en el interior de seis centrales hidroeléctricas de este pequeño país del Himalaya, donde el derrumbe de un glaciar el pasado miércoles provocó una gigantesca ola de lodo, rocas y agua que arrasó los valles montañosos, causando la muerte de más de 1.200 personas. Otros trabajadores de Upper Trishuli 3A estaban drenando el agua del interior del túnel y preparándose para llevar a cabo voladuras controladas perforando las enormes rocas, de modo que las excavadoras pudieran adentrarse más en el interior. Pueblos como Syabrubesi, que en su día fue una puerta de entrada a las rutas de senderismo del Himalaya salpicada de casas, aparecían ahora como una capa de barro grisáceo, de la que solo quedaban unos pocos edificios. No había signos visibles de vida en este escenario apocalíptico, señaló Chitrakar, y las marcas en las imponentes montañas a ambos lados del río Trishuli sugerían que las aguas de la crecida podrían haber subido hasta 500 metros por encima de los niveles normales. En el paso fronterizo de Gyirong, donde las imágenes de vigilancia mostraban a personas intentando huir segundos antes de que un alud de lodo engullera el cruce entre China y Nepal, se podía ver a algunos rescatistas con uniformes rojos junto con maquinaria pesada. Pero no quedaba nada en pie, según el fotógrafo de Reuters. Ni edificios, ni puerta, ni puente.

item.title: Hamilton comienza su fin de semana en Monza con estilo y dejando huella
item.description: Lewis Hamilton comenzó con fuerza su fin de semana del Gran Premio de Italia al presentarse en Monza por todo lo alto, al volante de su propio Ferrari F40, un coche de ensueño que, de niño, nunca pensó que llegaría a conducir.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Lewis Hamilton comenzó con fuerza su fin de semana del Gran Premio de Italia al presentarse en Monza por todo lo alto, al volante de su propio Ferrari F40, un coche de ensueño que, de niño, nunca pensó que llegaría a conducir. Desafiando el calor sofocante —se había declarado alerta por calor en el ultrarrápido e histórico "Templo de la Velocidad"—, el siete veces campeón del mundo de Fórmula Uno llegó el jueves con un elegante traje negro y posó para los fotógrafos con un grueso abrigo de color beige. Este look recordaba a su llegada a un Maranello lluvioso en enero del año pasado, cuando posó junto a un F40 con un impecable traje negro y abrigo. Hamilton, cinco veces ganador en Monza con McLaren y Mercedes, declaró a los periodistas que es "la mejor sensación" ser piloto de Ferrari en la carrera de casa de este glamuroso equipo y que quería estar a la altura de las circunstancias y destacar la historia. El piloto de 41 años, cuyo equipo celebra además el 30º aniversario de la primera victoria de Michael Schumacher en el Gran Premio de Italia, explicó que llevaba tiempo buscando un F40 —un auto que Ferrari fabricó entre 1987 y 1993, del que se vendieron unas 1.300 unidades— que tuviera una historia interesante y un bajo kilometraje. Encontró uno que había sido conducido desde la fábrica de Maranello hasta la casa de su propietario, a 69 kilómetros de distancia, y que nunca más se volvió a poner en marcha. La puerta del copiloto permaneció sin abrirse y el bólido cubierto con una lona protectora. Pero aún le esperaban más sorpresas al piloto que compite con el número 44. "Lo que también fue una locura es que, cuando desmontaron el auto para revisarlo, lo primero que vieron fue que había resistido el paso del tiempo. Todo seguía funcionando. Apenas hubo que cambiar nada", comentó. "Y cuando sacaron el motor, descubrieron que llevaba el número 44. El número 44 estaba grabado en el motor. No me lo podía creer", agregó. Si eso fue el destino, Hamilton esperará que vuelva a sonreírle en Monza, donde intentará recortar distancias con el líder del campeonato mundial de F1, Kimi Antonelli. Ferrari cuenta con una mejora del motor, mientras que el piloto de Mercedes comenzará la carrera desde la parte trasera de la parrilla debido a sanciones relacionadas con el motor. "Todo ayuda; todo ayuda", afirmó Hamilton, que está empatado a puntos con el segundo clasificado, George Russell, 59 puntos por debajo del italiano. El británico, que contará con la presencia de su madre este fin de semana en uno de los circuitos más emblemáticos y apasionantes de este deporte, afirmó que Ferrari cuenta ahora con una "estrella polar" —una orientación clara hacia donde deben llegar— de la que carecía la temporada pasada. "Ver cómo cada fin de semana llegan nuevas piezas que mejoran el auto es emocionante; demuestra que estamos avanzando. Sigo creyendo firmemente que tenemos lo que hace falta para ganar", añadió. "La presión es alta. Quieres dar lo mejor de ti por el equipo. Está toda esa gente que trabaja en la fábrica y muchos de ellos vendrán a esta carrera", indicó. "Los tifosi acuden en masa, su pasión es inigualable, y también quieres dar lo mejor de ti para ellos".

item.title: USA Lutnick s'excuse pour avoir dit qu'aucun Américain n'est mort pendant la guerre contre l'Iran
item.description: Le secrétaire américain au Commerce, Howard Lutnick, a présenté jeudi ses excuses pour avoir déclaré à la télévision qu'aucun soldat américain n'avait été tué depuis le début de la guerre contre l'Iran, disant avoir fait une confusion avec l'opération militaire américaine au Venezuela.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le secrétaire américain au Commerce, Howard Lutnick, a présenté jeudi ses excuses pour avoir déclaré à la télévision qu'aucun soldat américain n'avait été tué depuis le début de la guerre contre l'Iran, disant avoir fait une confusion avec l'opération militaire américaine au Venezuela. "Je me suis mal exprimé. Dix-huit membres de nos forces armées ont perdu la vie, et je suis profondément attristé pour ces familles ; je leur présente mes sincères condoléances. Je pensais à l'opération militaire au Venezuela, au cours de laquelle aucun militaire n'a perdu la vie", a dit Howard Lutnick dans un message publié sur X. Le secrétaire au Commerce a tenu ces propos mercredi lors d'une interview accordée à la chaîne CNBC, au cours de laquelle il n'a pas été question du Venezuela. Evoquant la gestion par Donald Trump de "la situation avec l'Iran", Howard Lutnick s'est dit convaincu que la stratégie d'étranglement économique allait être "très efficace", après s'être félicité qu'il n'y ait "pas eu de victimes américaines" dans ce conflit.

item.title: Malte Tensions après l'acquittement du commanditaire présumé de l'assassinat d'une journaliste
item.description: Le gouvernement maltais a appelé au calme après l'acquittement d'un homme d'affaires accusé d'avoir commandité l'assassinat, en 2017, de la journaliste d'investigation Daphne Caruana Galizia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le gouvernement maltais a appelé au calme après l'acquittement d'un homme d'affaires accusé d'avoir commandité l'assassinat, en 2017, de la journaliste d'investigation Daphne Caruana Galizia. La journaliste et militante anti-corruption, âgée de 53 ans, a été tuée dans un attentat à la voiture piégée devant son domicile en octobre 2017. Son assassinat a déclenché une tempête politique à Malte et braqué les projecteurs sur la police et le système judiciaire de l'île. Le verdict rendu mercredi soir à l'issue du procès du commanditaire présumé a provoqué la colère de la famille de la victime et d'une partie de la classe politique, et suscité les critiques de l'organisation Reporters sans frontières (RSF), qui s'est dite "plus qu'indignée" de "l'absence de justice pleine et entière près d'une décennie après le crime". Roberta Metsola, présidente du Parlement européen et ancienne responsable politique maltaise, s'est engagée à tout faire pour que justice soit rendue. "Nous n'abandonnerons pas et nous ne céderons pas", a-t-elle promis. Dans un communiqué, le gouvernement maltais a lancé un appel "à la prudence dans les déclarations publiques qui pourraient faire plus de mal que de bien". À l'issue de précédents procès, trois hommes avaient été condamnés à de lourdes peines de prison pour avoir commis l'assassinat et deux autres pour avoir fourni la bombe. En revanche, l'homme d'affaires Yorgen Fenech, héritier d'un empire immobilier comprenant notamment des hôtels et des casinos, a été acquitté mercredi par un vote du jury à huit voix contre une des chefs d'accusation de complicité et d'association de malfaiteurs en vue de commettre un assassinat. La journaliste, est-il noté dans l'acte d'accusation, était sur le point de publier un article compromettant sur l'un des proches de Fenech avant d'être assassinée. Le parquet ne peut pas faire appel du verdict, sauf dans des circonstances exceptionnelles liées à des points de droit.

item.title: Bank of England's Pill says higher rates would help head off inflation pressure
item.description: Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill said that raising interest rates now would help reduce the chance that the central bank has to be more aggressive in future to tame inflation which has picked up as a result of the Iran war.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill said that raising interest rates now would help reduce the chance that the central bank has to be more aggressive in future to tame inflation which has picked up as a result of the Iran war. "Raising Bank Rate ... need not be the start of a prolonged and aggressive series of increases," Pill said in comments that he was due to deliver to the Edinburgh Chamber of Commerce later on Thursday. "Implemented and communicated effectively, a prompt increase in Bank Rate may serve to head-off some of the potential insidious 'catch up' nominal dynamics that threaten to make temporary departures of inflation from target more persistent," he added. Pill and two other Monetary Policy Committee members voted to raise interest rates in July. But they were outvoted by colleagues who preferred no change as they awaited clearer signs of what the Iran war means for long-term inflation pressures. Investors in interest rate futures on Thursday priced the chance of a quarter-point rate hike at the MPC's next meeting this month at little more than 15% although that probability rose to more than 70% for the subsequent meeting in November.

item.title: Boeing predicts Africa aircraft fleet will more than double by 2045
item.description: Africa's commercial aircraft fleet will more than double by 2045, U.S. planemaker Boeing forecast on Thursday, as a young and increasingly urban population drives demand for travel within the continent and to the Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Nzilani
item.content:encoded: Africa's commercial aircraft fleet will more than double by 2045, U.S. planemaker Boeing (BA.N) forecast on Thursday, as a young and increasingly urban population drives demand for travel within the continent and to the Middle East. The following are further points from its annual Commercial Market Outlook. Africa's fleet will grow to 1,625 aircraft in 2045 from 755 in 2025, requiring 1,165 airplane deliveries over the next two decades. Single-aisle aircraft, used mainly on domestic and regional routes, will account for 870 of the forecast deliveries, or about three-quarters of the total. Boeing expects deliveries of 240 wide-body jets, which are typically used on longer international routes, and 15 cargo planes. Passenger traffic within Africa is expected to grow 6.5% annually through 2045. Africa-Middle East traffic would expand 7.1% a year, the fastest rate among the region's major travel markets. Traffic between Africa and Europe is projected to grow 3.4% annually. The region's cargo fleet is expected to rise to 150 freighters from 60, supported by growth in logistics, e-commerce and exports. Carriers including Ethiopian Airlines, EgyptAir and Kenya Airways (KQNA.NR) , whose fleets mainly consist of Boeing and Airbus (AIR.PA) jets for long-haul routes, dominate the African market. Boeing's Managing Director Commercial Marketing Africa and Middle East Shahab Matin said Africa's market was "entering a period of sustained growth driven by improving connectivity, expanding intraregional travel and deeper economic ties". Africa's dominant carriers typically use Embraer (EMBJ3.SA) , ATR and De Havilland planes on regional routes. But Matin said Boeing could also provide appropriate carriers. Boeing also estimated that Africa's aviation services market, including maintenance, repair, overhaul, modifications and digital services, would be worth $140 billion over the 2026-2045 period. Meeting the expansion will require 75,000 additional aviation workers, including 22,000 pilots, 25,000 technicians and 28,000 cabin crew, Boeing said. The forecast is a long-term market outlook rather than an order projection.

item.title: Real Madrid's Asencio acquitted in sex-video sharing case
item.description: Real Madrid defender Raul Asencio was on Thursday cleared of charges related to sharing a video of sexual content without the victims' consent, a court on the Spanish island of Gran Canaria said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Real Madrid defender Raul Asencio was on Thursday cleared of charges related to sharing a video of sexual content without the victims' consent, a court on the Spanish island of Gran Canaria said. Prosecutors dropped the charges against Asencio and reduced their sentencing requests for three other former Real Madrid youth players after the victims told the court they had forgiven the defendants. The other three players, who were charged with recording and sharing sexual videos of two teenage women, one of them underage, were sentenced to one year in prison. The sentences were suspended on condition that they commit no further offences during that period. Asencio was only accused of sharing the video. In an unrelated incident, Asencio was fined €14,400 ($16,800) and banned from driving for eight months after being caught driving under the influence of alcohol, another court said on Wednesday. Earlier on Thursday, Real Madrid coach José Mourinho said the club had opened disciplinary proceedings against the player, but that Asencio would remain part of his plans while the matter was being resolved. "Everything you do outside your professional sphere still reflects on Real Madrid and continues to damage the reputation of a club whose standing must not be undermined," Mourinho said. "I'm not happy. Everyone makes mistakes, but a series of mistakes is something different." Asencio has not played for the Spanish club this season because of an injury that is expected to keep him out for a couple more weeks, Mourinho said. ($1 = €0.8601)

item.title: Mais de 1.700 pessoas adoecem após consumirem refeições escolares gratuitas na Indonésia em três dias
item.description: Mais 777 alunos e professores sofreram intoxicação alimentar na província de Java Central, na Indonésia, após consumirem refeições gratuitas distribuídas pelo governo, informou a diretora de uma escola nesta quinta-feira, elevando para mais de 1.700 o número total de pessoas que adoeceram devido ao programa em três dias.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mais 777 alunos e professores sofreram intoxicação alimentar na província de Java Central, na Indonésia, após consumirem refeições gratuitas distribuídas pelo governo, informou a diretora de uma escola nesta quinta-feira, elevando para mais de 1.700 o número total de pessoas que adoeceram devido ao programa em três dias. Em incidentes separados em três outros locais nesta semana, 950 indonésios adoeceram em consequência de intoxicação alimentar relacionada ao programa, informou um membro de uma comissão parlamentar responsável pela supervisão da saúde. O presidente Prabowo Subianto lançou no ano passado o programa de refeições gratuitas, avaliado em bilhões de dólares, para melhorar a nutrição de dezenas de milhões de crianças, mas o oneroso programa tem sido marcado por denúncias de corrupção, mudanças na liderança e uma série de surtos de intoxicação alimentar em massa. O armazenamento inadequado dos alimentos e o atraso na entrega das refeições preparadas costumam ser os responsáveis pela intoxicação alimentar. Em uma escola de ensino médio em Lasem, na província de Java Central, 752 alunos e 25 professores vêm sofrendo de diarreia e vômitos após consumirem refeições gratuitas na quarta-feira, disse a diretora da escola, Juhartutik. Os alunos de Lasem receberam frango grelhado. Antes da distribuição, um provador de alimentos constatou que parte da comida estava “viscosa”, declarou Juhartutik. “Os pedaços viscosos já haviam sido separados... O responsável pela cozinha disse que a comida foi preparada às 3h da manhã e consumida ao meio-dia”, disse ela, acrescentando que a maioria das vítimas foi mandada para casa. Joko Paryanto, um médico local que atendeu as vítimas, disse que 15 alunos e professores foram hospitalizados. Sudaryono, chefe da Agência Nacional de Nutrição, que supervisiona o programa de US$12,94 bilhões, disse em audiência no Parlamento que os casos de intoxicação alimentar seriam tratados “com seriedade”.

item.title: Leeds suffer Rodon injury blow
item.description: Leeds United's Wales defender Joe Rodon is likely to be missing for up to 10 weeks after injuring his hamstring during the draw with Brentford in the Premier League last week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Leeds United's Wales defender Joe Rodon is likely to be missing for up to 10 weeks after injuring his hamstring during the draw with Brentford in the Premier League last week. Manager Daniel Farke confirmed the news as he spoke ahead of the trip to Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday. "Yes, bad news," he said on Thursday. "Joe has a hamstring injury. He will be out for, at the moment, an assessment of eight to 10 weeks, so he will definitely not play before the next international break. "Also, probably not the first games after the international break. A blow for us because he is a key player for us. But it is football and sometimes you have to deal also with injuries. He will definitely miss the next eight to 10 weeks." Rodon has started in both of Leeds' league games so far. His injury will also be a setback for Wales, who visit Portugal on September 24 and Denmark three days later in Nations League Group A4 matches in the next international break. They also host Norway and Denmark in home Nations League games at the start of October.

item.title: Rights groups urge US lawmakers to drop provision to deepen defense ties with Israel
item.description: Dozens of civil rights and advocacy groups are urging Congress to scrap a defense bill provision that would deepen U.S.-Israeli military technology ties, according to a letter seen by Reuters, at a time of growing U.S. skepticism toward the longtime ally.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk
item.content:encoded: Dozens of civil rights and advocacy groups are urging Congress to scrap a defense bill provision that would deepen U.S.-Israeli military technology ties, according to a letter seen by Reuters, at a time of growing U.S. skepticism toward the longtime ally. The provision would deepen cooperation between the U.S. and Israeli defense sectors by accelerating joint military technology development and other partnerships. The bill passed the House of Representatives in July and awaits Senate action. The provision of the 2027 National Defense Authorization Act, known as Section 219, seeks to set up frameworks for joint ventures, licensing agreements and U.S.-based co-production partnerships with the Israeli industry. In Thursday's letter addressed to leaders of the House and Senate Armed Services Committees, 56 groups said deeper integration with Israel's defense sector would be "exceptionally dangerous" and urged lawmakers to remove the provision. The groups include Amnesty International USA and the civil rights network National Lawyers Guild as well as Arab and Jewish advocacy groups. "At a time in which American interests are increasingly diverging from those of Israel, and American public opinion is turning increasingly against unconditional support to Israel, creating new points of influence for Israel in the U.S. defense-technology ecosystem is exceptionally dangerous," said the letter, which has not been previously reported. Israel is one of Washington's closest allies in the Middle East, and the two countries cooperate extensively on defense and intelligence issues. Supporters say deeper ties could help speed military innovation and technology development. A spokesperson from the Israeli Embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment on this story. But Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in a May interview with CBS that he hoped to wean Israel off U.S. military support within a decade. In a June letter to a U.S. congressman he wrote that the time has come for Israel "to move from aid recipient to partner." U.S. PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR ISRAEL DECLINES U.S. public support for Israel has fallen since the Gaza war began in 2023, particularly among Democrats. A June Quinnipiac University poll found 48% of voters and 66% of Democrats believe the United States is too supportive of Israel, up from 16% and 20% when the question was first asked in 2017. Support for Israel among Democratic voters has plummeted, [USN:L1N4170SE TEXT:"candidates critical of Israel"] are winning Democratic primaries and even moderate lawmakers are increasingly willing to challenge decades of U.S. support for Israel. The Islamist militant Hamas group, in an October 7, 2023, attack on Israel, killed nearly 1,200 Israelis and foreign nationals and took hundreds hostage. More than 73,000 Palestinians have since been killed in Israel's subsequent assault on Gaza, according to Gaza health officials. The letter criticizes Israel for its potential violations of international humanitarian law in its war in Gaza and rising settler violence against Palestinians in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. It says such developments should prevent any discussion of deepening military ties. A memorandum of understanding that provides $3.8 billion annual U.S. military aid to Israel is approaching its expiration date in 2028 and conversations are under way on how Washington's assistance to Israel would evolve beyond that date. Some members of Congress have already tried to strip the provision from the fiscal 2027 NDAA. Republican Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky and Democratic Representative Ro Khanna of California introduced an amendment to block it, but it did not make it into the House version of the bill. Once the House and Senate write their versions of the NDAA, members of the two chambers work out a compromise version of the bill, which must pass both chambers - typically near the end of the calendar year - before it can be sent to the White House for President Donald Trump to sign into law or veto.

item.title: IEA chief says Nigeria could double energy investment within five years
item.description: Nigeria could double investment into its energy sector within five years after joining the International Energy Agency, its chief Fatih Birol said on Thursday, as nations seek partners they can "trust" after supply disruptions from the wars in Iran and Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Chijioke Ohuocha
item.content:encoded: Nigeria could double investment into its energy sector within five years after joining the International Energy Agency, its chief Fatih Birol said on Thursday, as nations seek partners they can "trust" after supply disruptions from the wars in Iran and Ukraine. Speaking during a visit to Abuja, Birol told Reuters that Nigeria's admission as an associate member of the Paris-based energy watchdog would help attract investment, deepen technical cooperation and give Africa's largest oil producer a stronger voice in global energy policy discussions. "My goal is, in a very short period of time, in five years, at least doubling the energy investments Nigeria is receiving today," Birol said. Nigeria, Africa's top oil producer, needs substantial capital to unlock opportunities across oil, gas and renewable energy, particularly solar power, he said. Birol said Nigeria's resource base, together with shifting global energy trade patterns, could help attract capital from governments and private investors seeking reliable energy partners. "The most scarce commodity is not oil, not gas, not uranium, not lithium. It is trust," he said. "Countries are looking for partners they can rely on." He described Nigeria as a credible energy supplier and said exports from the [USN:L4N44L18W TEXT:"Dangote refinery"], which processes about 700,000 barrels of crude a day, had helped ease fuel-supply pressures in Europe in recent months. EXPANSION PLANS Nigeria aims to nearly [USN:L8N4430OU TEXT:"double oil production"] to 3 million barrels per day by 2030 and is counting on energy sector reform, infrastructure upgrades and improved security to prevent oil theft to help attract foreign capital after years of underinvestment. Nigeria became an [USN:L1N43409N TEXT:"associate member"] of the IEA in July after the agency's member countries, including the United States, Germany, Italy and Japan, unanimously approved its application, Birol said. The IEA and Nigeria are expected to sign a joint work programme in Abuja outlining cooperation in areas including natural gas, electrification, clean cooking, energy efficiency and energy data development. Nigeria will work with the IEA to improve areas such as energy data collection and reporting systems, an area investors and market participants have long cited as lacking, particularly for oil production, export and consumption statistics. ENERGY SECURITY RISKS Birol said geopolitical tensions and disruptions to major energy supply routes were reshaping global trade flows and creating risks for consumers. Countries have been reassessing energy partnerships and supply chains following market disruptions caused by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine and instability along key shipping routes, he said. "If the Strait of Hormuz is not going to open convincingly sometime soon, we may have some difficulties both in terms of crude oil, but especially on products such as diesel and jet fuel," Birol said. He said the coming weeks and months would be critical for maintaining a healthy balance between global oil supply and demand.

item.title: US pressure on Iran starting to tell, as sanctions and blockade bite
item.description: A U.S. campaign to throttle Iran's economy by blockading its oil exports and stopping sanctions evasion is growing increasingly difficult to withstand, three senior Iranian sources said.
item.dc:creator: Parisa Hafezi, Angus Mcdowall
item.content:encoded: A U.S. campaign to throttle Iran's economy by [USN:L8N44N1OO TEXT:"blockading its oil exports"] and stopping sanctions evasion is growing increasingly difficult to withstand, three senior Iranian sources said. Washington has in recent weeks sought to ratchet up the economic pressure on Tehran, in an effort to extract concessions in any future negotiation that six months of conflict have so far failed to secure. Although Iran's clerical rulers managed to bypass sanctions for decades, the [USN:L6N44T0TA TEXT:"latest U.S. moves"] have left them in a far more sensitive position, with few remaining channels to secure foreign currency or buy goods, the sources said. In particular, the effort to stop Iran accessing international financing networks in other countries it has long used to keep its economy functioning poses a real and urgent threat, the sources said. Any sign the economic campaign may break a months-long deadlock in the conflict will likely cheer U.S. planners, though Iran has also warned it could respond to the pressure with military escalation, raising the stakes at a key moment. PETROL STOCKS LOW AS CURRENCY COLLAPSES The war has erupted back into [USN:L6N44V04Z TEXT:"open fighting"] this week, with U.S. attacks along Iran's Gulf coast prompting retaliatory Iranian strikes at U.S. bases in Arab states. Neither side has signalled yet it is ready to make the concessions demanded by the other, leaving the war in a costly stalemate - though one that may be shifting. While more energy is flowing to international markets through the Strait of Hormuz despite Iranian efforts to continue disrupting the seaway, the U.S. blockade of Iranian oil exports has entirely cut off Tehran's main source of revenue. Adding to Iran's problems, the economy was already deep in crisis before the conflict, with a cratering currency and spiralling inflation, while months of bombing have run up a massive bill to rebuild damaged industry and infrastructure. Meanwhile, the country's financial squeeze is itself biting into Tehran's efforts to get around the sanctions regime, leaving less cash to pay the high premiums required to skirt sanctions illicitly, the sources said. The rial has fallen to record lows over recent days and one senior source said Iran only has another two months' supply of gasoline, which has to be imported despite domestic oil production because of limited refining capacity. Iran's rulers are keenly aware of the potential risks of an economic meltdown and the possibility of it reigniting the nationwide mass protests it put down in January by killing thousands of demonstrators. "They are under very, very severe economic pressure. They're losing control of the Straits. It's really a question of if they choose to negotiate and I think they'll have to," said Ali Ansari, modern history professor at St Andrews University in Scotland. The war is also entering a new phase, with each side trying to influence each other's politics. Iran hopes the threat of inflation will deter the U.S. administration before midterm elections in November, while Washington aims to push Iranians to revolt, a senior Iranian official said. BLOCKADE AND SECONDARY SANCTIONS SQUEEZING TEHRAN The latest U.S. measures expanded secondary sanctions that target countries doing business with Iran in a bid to stop it clearing dollar transactions needed for both oil sales and to finance crucial imports of goods and raw materials. That effort is making Iran's existing sanctions evasion networks - front companies, unregistered tankers and smuggling - too expensive to use, the three senior sources said. Iranian crude loadings have fallen this month to about 260,000 barrels a day, from about 1.7 million a year earlier, according to data from commodity analytics firm Kpler, with only a trickle still moving off terminals for distribution by truck, train or smaller boats over the Caspian Sea. Tehran says it still has tens of millions of barrels stored in tankers outside the blockade zone that it can sell, but the new sanctions mean intermediaries are stepping back or demanding more money, one of the officials said. Total trade has fallen between 25% and 35%, with imports hit harder than exports, President Masoud Pezeshkian has said, one of several top officials warning in recent weeks about Iran's rapidly deteriorating situation. U.S. pressure and Iran's own attacks have meanwhile disrupted one of the main conduits for Iranian trade - the United Arab Emirates, which said on August 19 that all commercial exchange and financial dealings with Tehran were halted until further notice. “If those channels stay closed, a supplier wants cash, a deal is routed through another country and a shipment arrives later and dearer,” said an Iranian trader in Tehran who deals in imported goods. The currency has collapsed in value from around 1 million rials to the dollar a year ago to over 2.2 million rials now. The internal impact is very painful. Official figures put 12-month average inflation at 69.9% with food, beverages and tobacco prices rising at nearly twice that rate. Official unemployment rose to 9.1% in the spring, while the number of those in work fell by about 450,000 from a year earlier amid a wider fall in labour force participation. Even for those still in work, the average monthly salary of around $125 a month comes nowhere near meeting basic household spending requirements that come to around $450 a month according to official data. "We are getting poorer every day," said Mahnaz, a 34-year-old private-sector employee in Tehran who asked that her family name not be used.

item.title: Volkswagen Caminhões e Ônibus anuncia parceria com chinesa Saic para nova família de veículos comerciais leves
item.description: A Volkswagen Caminhões e Ônibus anunciou nesta quarta-feira uma parceria com a chinesa Saic Motors no desenvolvimento de uma nova famíla de veículos no segmento de comerciais leves.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Volkswagen Caminhões e Ônibus anunciou nesta quarta-feira uma parceria com a chinesa Saic Motors no desenvolvimento de uma nova famíla de veículos no segmento de comerciais leves. O veículo desenvolvido em conjunto será apresentado em novembro, disse o presidente-executivo da VWCO, Roberto Cortes, em anúncio à imprensa. A tradicional fabricante brasileira de veículos pesados e integrante do grupo Traton não trabalha no segmento de comerciais leves atualmente, um dos principais do mercado brasileiro de veículos. O veículo será produzido na China em um primeiro momento e será importado pronto ao Brasil e Argentina. A empresa pretende desenvolver ao longo do tempo processo de localização na América do Sul, disse Cortes. "A montagem completa é na China num primeiro momento para chegar rapidamente ao mercado", afirmou.

item.title: Burnham and Macron discuss drive to get UK 'closer to Europe'
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and French President Emmanuel Macron discussed Britain's "drive to get closer to Europe" in a meeting in London, a Downing Street spokesperson said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and French President Emmanuel Macron discussed Britain's "drive to get closer to Europe" in a meeting in London, a Downing Street spokesperson said on Thursday. During their discussion, Burnham told his French counterpart that the European Union's [USN:L1N3ZF0BV TEXT:"Made in Europe agenda"], which could see the EU prioritising European-made goods in public contracts, "could pose significant challenges for UK industry", the spokesperson added. Burnham last month said Britain [USN:L8N44L0BK TEXT:"should be bolder"] in pursuing closer ties with the European Union. In Thursday's meeting with Macron, the two "agreed it was vital to work together to find a way forward to protect shared interests," the spokesperson also said. The two leaders' meeting on Thursday followed a [USN:L8N44U24P TEXT:"visit with Britain's King Charles"] on Wednesday to the exhibition housing the historic Bayeux Tapestry, which has been loaned to the British Museum from its home in northern France under a deal struck with the French government.

item.title: All Blacks hope to get out of blocks quicker in third South Africa test
item.description: New Zealand coach Dave Rennie is looking for a quicker start from his team when they take on South Africa in Saturday’s third test at Soccer City in Johannesburg after falling behind early on in the opening two internationals.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New Zealand coach Dave Rennie is looking for a quicker start from his team when they take on South Africa in Saturday’s third test at Soccer City in Johannesburg after falling behind early on in the opening two internationals. The All Blacks had to fight back to [USN:L6N44J052 TEXT:"win the first test "]in Johannesburg and were trailing from the second minute against the Springboks in last Saturday’s [USN:L6N44Q05W TEXT:"second test "]in Cape Town. “A big part of our game is our continuity, but we need to really front up as well. Starting quicker would be pretty important,” Rennie told a press conference on Thursday. “We've put a bit of time into that part of our game. But our big men at the set pieces is crucial as we know and we think we've got a group of guys who’ll work hard around the field and provide opportunities for us." With the series poised at 1-1, the Kiwi coach made [USN:L6N44V0SX TEXT:"three changes"] to the pack in a bid to add extra energy and also fix up their struggles with the lineout. “I said a couple of weeks ago that it's going to take more than 23 guys to win the series here, so it's much about sharing the load,” he said of the axing of veteran hooker Codie Taylor, who is replaced by Asafo Aumua. “We've made a couple of shifts for the lineout, I won't divulge too much but that we think it will make the task a lot easier. “As we know, with a lineout there’s got a lot more to do than just the hooker and so we expect to be better there this week,” added Rennie. ERR ON THE SIDE OF CAUTION In the second row, Sam Darry will play a first test of the series with Fabian Holland dropped to the bench while Josh Lord rests again after suffering concussion in the first test. “There’s not much between our locks but Josh Lord had his first day back at training today so we decided not to consider him. He's had a bit of a history of concussion and so we're going to err on the side of caution. “Sam Darry hasn't played in the test series but has a massive engine and that’s how we want to play. That'll be handy at altitude, we think.” Rennie said he also expected an impact from Peter Lakai who replaces Simon Parker on the side of the scrum. “He's not a big loose forward compared to maybe some of the other men on the field, especially in the opposition, but he's really physical. He hits in the tackle and clean and then he's a hell of an athlete and so what you lose a little bit in bulk, he'll give us plenty around the track. "He’s started a couple of other tests this year and he's always fronted when given an opportunity.”

item.title: Astros da Copa do Mundo geram US$3,3 bilhões em taxas de transferências
item.description: Os jogadores que atuaram na Copa do Mundo de 2026 geraram mais de US$3,3 bilhões em taxas de transferência internacional durante a janela de transferências do meio do ano, que acabou recentemente, informou a Fifa nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os jogadores que atuaram na Copa do Mundo de 2026 geraram mais de US$3,3 bilhões em taxas de transferência internacional durante a janela de transferências do meio do ano, que acabou recentemente, informou a Fifa nesta quinta-feira. Mais de 260 jogadores da Copa do Mundo, de 47 nacionalidades, mudaram de clube durante a janela, representando mais de um terço do valor recorde de US$9,89 bilhões gastos em taxas de transferência internacional no futebol masculino, de acordo com a entidade que rege o futebol mundial. “Mais de 12.500 transferências internacionais foram registradas em todo o mundo, estabelecendo também um novo recorde para o número de transferências durante uma janela de meio de ano”, afirmou a Fifa em um estudo. A onda de gastos ocorreu após a Espanha conquistar a Copa do Mundo em julho, destacando como o desempenho no maior palco do futebol ajudou a impulsionar gastos recordes em todo o mercado global. Vários jogadores de destaque da Copa do Mundo garantiram transferências milionárias durante a janela, incluindo a mudança do meio-campista espanhol Rodri, do Manchester City para o Barcelona, e a transferência do ponta francês Bradley Barcola, do Paris Saint-Germain para o Liverpool. O futebol feminino também registrou recordes, com os gastos com transferências internacionais mais que dobrando em relação a 2025, chegando a US$28,6 milhões, informou a Fifa. “Um total de 1.406 transferências internacionais foram registradas no futebol profissional feminino – o maior número já registrado e um aumento de 19,2% em relação ao recorde anterior”, disse a entidade. Os clubes ingleses lideraram os gastos nos mercados de transferências internacionais masculino e feminino, respondendo por US$3,02 bilhões em taxas de transferência no futebol masculino e US$8,0 milhões no futebol feminino.

item.title: PayPal cuts 220 India jobs as part of previously announced restructuring plan, source says
item.description: PayPal has cut roughly 220 jobs in India as part of the payments firm's broader, multi-year turnaround plan laid out earlier this year, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Manya Saini
item.content:encoded: PayPal (PYPL.O) has cut roughly 220 jobs in India as part of the payments firm's broader, [USN:L4N41I0OH TEXT:"multi-year turnaround plan"] laid out earlier this year, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday. Here are some more details: "The recent staffing changes are part of our previously announced multi-year transformation to simplify our global operations, strengthen execution, and position the company for long-term growth," a PayPal spokesperson said in an emailed statement. The firm [USN:L4N43T1J3 TEXT:"has outlined extensive cost-saving measures"] this year under newly appointed CEO, Enrique Lores, as it seeks to sharpen its competitive position in the crowded payments market. PayPal has set a target of achieving $400 million in cost savings by year-end and at least $1.5 billion over the next two to three years. Among the initiatives are plans to reduce organizational layers, improve productivity and integrate AI and automation across the business. It joins a [USN:L4N3YS22G TEXT:"growing list"] of U.S. companies that have announced job cuts this year. The [USN:L1N43I0ZO TEXT:"rise of fintech rivals and big-tech players"] such as Apple and Google in payments has chipped away at PayPal's market share in recent years, weighing on its stock. The company's shares are down roughly 82% from its 2021 record high. In its latest earnings report, PayPal raised its full-year profit forecast after quarterly results topped Wall Street expectations. The turnaround initiatives come against a backdrop of takeover speculation around the company. Reuters reported in July, citing sources, that a consortium including payments company Stripe and private equity firm Advent had made a [USN:L6N43H05T TEXT:"$53 billion offer"] to buy PayPal. The suitors are no longer pursuing the deal, according to [USN:L4N44P0L3 TEXT:"media reports in late August"].

item.title: Hamilton starts his Monza weekend with style and statement
item.description: Lewis Hamilton made a statement start to his Italian Grand Prix weekend by reporting for duty at Monza in style and at the wheel of his own Ferrari F40 - a dream car he never thought as a boy he would ever get to drive.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Lewis Hamilton made a statement start to his Italian Grand Prix weekend by reporting for duty at Monza in style and at the wheel of his own Ferrari F40 - a dream car he never thought as a boy he would ever get to drive. Defying the sweltering weather, with a [USN:L6N44V0SH TEXT:"heat hazard"] declared at the super-fast and history-laden 'Temple of Speed', the seven times Formula One world champion arrived on Thursday in a sharp black suit and posed for photographers in a thick tan overcoat. The look referred back to his own arrival at a wet Maranello in January last year, when he posed alongside an F40 in impeccable black suit and overcoat. Hamilton, a five times winner at Monza with McLaren and Mercedes, told reporters it was "the best feeling" to be a Ferrari driver at the glamour team's home race and he wanted to live up to the occasion and highlight the history. The 41-year-old, whose team are also [USN:L6N44T0R6 TEXT:"celebrating the 30th anniversary"] of Michael Schumacher's first Italian GP win, explained that he had been looking for some time for an F40 -- a car that Ferrari built from 1987 to 1993 with around 1,300 examples sold -- with both an interesting story and low mileage. He found one that had been driven from the Maranello factory to the owner's house 69km away and was never started again. The passenger door remained unopened and the car covered in a dust sheet. There were also more surprises in store for the driver who races with the number 44. "What was also crazy is when they were taking the car apart to check it, firstly, it stood the test of time. Everything was still working. Hardly anything had to be changed," said Hamilton. "And when they took the engine out, they found out the engine’s number 44. It's got stamped on the engine number 44. I couldn’t believe it." ENGINE UPGRADE FOR FERRARI'S HOME RACE If that was fate, then Hamilton will be hoping it smiles on him again at Monza as he seeks to close the gap on Formula One championship leader Kimi Antonelli. Ferrari have an engine upgrade while Mercedes driver Antonelli will be starting his home race at the back of the grid due to engine penalties. "Every little helps; every little helps," said Hamilton, who is who is level on points with second-placed George Russell and 59 behind Antonelli. The Briton, who will have his mother in attendance this weekend at one of the sport's truly great and most passionate venues, said Ferrari now had a 'north star' -- clear guidance towards where they needed to be -- that was lacking last season. "To see bits coming each weekend, adding to the car, it’s exciting to see that we are pushing. I strongly still believe that we’ve got what it takes to win,” he added. "The pressure’s high. You want to deliver for the team. There’s all those people that are at the factory and many of them will come to this race. "The tifosi come out in huge numbers, the passion is unmatched, and you want to deliver for them as well."

item.title: Estrellas del Mundial generan 3.300 millones de dólares en derechos de traspaso, gasto alcanza máximos
item.description: Los jugadores que participaron en el Mundial de 2026 generaron más de 3.300 millones de dólares en derechos de traspaso internacionales durante el mercado de fichajes de mitad de año que acaba de concluir, informó la FIFA este jueves.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los jugadores que participaron en el Mundial de 2026 generaron más de 3.300 millones de dólares en derechos de traspaso internacionales durante el mercado de fichajes de mitad de año que acaba de concluir, informó la FIFA este jueves. Más de 260 jugadores del Mundial, de 47 nacionalidades diferentes, cambiaron de club durante este periodo, lo que supone más de un tercio de los 9.890 millones de dólares gastados en derechos de traspaso internacionales en el fútbol masculino, según el organismo rector mundial de este deporte. "Se registraron más de 12.500 traspasos internacionales en todo el mundo, lo que también supone un nuevo récord en cuanto al número de traspasos durante un mercado de verano", señaló la FIFA en un estudio. Esta oleada de gasto se produjo después de que España se alzara con el título del Mundial en julio, lo que pone de relieve cómo las actuaciones en el mayor escenario del fútbol contribuyeron a impulsar un gasto récord en todo el mercado mundial. Varios jugadores destacados del Mundial cerraron fichajes millonarios durante este periodo, entre ellos el del centrocampista español Rodri, que pasó del Manchester City al Barcelona, y el del extremo francés Bradley Barcola, que se trasladó del París Saint-Germain al Liverpool. El fútbol femenino también batió récords: el gasto en traspasos internacionales se duplicó con creces con respecto a 2025, hasta alcanzar los 28,6 millones de dólares, según la FIFA. "Se registraron un total de 1.406 traspasos internacionales en el fútbol profesional femenino, la cifra más alta jamás registrada y un aumento del 19,2 % en comparación con el récord anterior", señaló la FIFA. Los clubes ingleses lideraron el gasto en los mercados de fichajes internacionales tanto masculino como femenino, con 3.020 millones de dólares en derechos de traspaso masculinos y 8,0 millones de dólares en el fútbol femenino.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die US-Dienstleister haben ihr Wachstumstempo im August überraschend kräftig gesteigert. Der Einkaufsmanagerindex für die Serviceunternehmen legte im August auf 55,4 Punkte von 54,1 Zählern im Vormonat zu, wie aus der am Donnerstag veröffentlichten monatlichen Umfrage des Institute for Supply Management (ISM) hervorgeht. Je weiter das Barometer über der Schwelle von 50 Punkten liegt, desto mehr Wachstum signalisiert es. Von Reuters befragte Volkswirte hatten nur mit einem Anstieg auf 54,2 Punkte gerechnet. "Mit Blick auf den Arbeitsmarktbericht, der am Freitag mit Spannung erwartet wird, sei auf den Beschäftigungssubindex verwiesen: Dieser ist leicht gestiegen, bleibt aber unterhalb der Expansionsschwelle", erläuterte Helaba-Experte Ulrich Wortberg ISM-Zahlen zur Stellenentwicklung im Servicesektor. Für den Arbeitsmarktreport der US-Regierung erwarten Ökonomen ein Stellenplus von 56.000 im August, nach einem überraschenden Rückgang um 23.000 im Juli. Die US-Notenbank Federal Reserve hat diese Kennzahlen genau im Blick, da sie für Vollbeschäftigung und auch für stabile Preise sorgen soll. Sie hat den Leitzins zuletzt im Zielkorridor von 3,50 bis 3,75 Prozent belassen. Fed-Direktoriumsmitglied Christopher Waller macht sein Abstimmungsverhalten bei der nächsten Zinssitzung Mitte September von frisch hereinkommenden Inflationsdaten abhängig. Sollten weitere Fortschritte in Richtung des Zwei-Prozent-Ziels der Federal Reserve erkennbar sein, sei er für eine weitere Zinspause, sagte er im [USN:L8N44V0ND TEXT:"'Reuters Next Newsmaker'-Interview"]. [USN:L8N44V17S TEXT:"Händler"] sahen die Wahrscheinlichkeit einer Zinserhöhung der US-Notenbank danach bei etwa 54 Prozent, gegenüber etwa 62 Prozent vor Wallers Aussagen. Die Wetten auf steigende Zinsen hatten an den Terminmärkten stark zugenommen - auch weil Fed-Chef Kevin Warsh Sorge über die hartnäckig hohe Inflation geäußert hatte.

item.title: Sólida demanda impulsa la actividad del sector servicios de EEUU en agosto
item.description: La actividad del sector servicios de Estados Unidos repuntó en agosto, ya que la fuerte demanda elevó los nuevos pedidos a su máximo en tres años y medio e impulsó los precios de los insumos, lo que sugiere que la inflación podría mantenerse elevada y obligar a la Reserva Federal a subir las tasas de interés antes de que termine este año.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La actividad del sector servicios de Estados Unidos repuntó en agosto, ya que la fuerte demanda elevó los nuevos pedidos a su máximo en tres años y medio e impulsó los precios de los insumos, lo que sugiere que la inflación podría mantenerse elevada y obligar a la Reserva Federal a subir las tasas de interés antes de que termine este año. El Instituto de Gerencia y Abastecimiento anunció el jueves que su Índice de Gerentes de Compras (PMI) no manufacturero avanzó a 55,4 el mes pasado, frente al 54,1 registrado en julio. Una lectura superior a 50 indica crecimiento en el sector servicios, que representa más de dos tercios de la actividad económica del país. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters proyectaban que el PMI subiría a 54,2. El nivel actual del PMI es coherente con un sólido crecimiento económico en el tercer trimestre. El indicador de la encuesta relativo a los nuevos pedidos recibidos por las empresas de servicios se disparó a 60,9, la cifra más alta desde febrero de 2023, desde el 57,2 registrado en julio. La fortaleza de los pedidos concuerda con una sólida demanda interna, impulsada en parte por un auge del gasto en inteligencia artificial. Dado que la demanda no muestra signos de enfriamiento, las cadenas de suministro siguieron sometidas a presión el mes pasado. El indicador de la encuesta relativo a las entregas de los proveedores descendió a 51,3, desde el 52,8 registrado en julio. Una lectura superior a 50 indica una ralentización de las entregas. Este indicador lleva 21 meses consecutivos de desaceleración, lo que ha provocado un aumento de los precios de los insumos. El desempeño de las entregas de los proveedores se vio afectado inicialmente por los aranceles a las importaciones y, más recientemente, por la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán, que ya lleva siete meses. El indicador de la encuesta sobre los precios pagados por las empresas por los insumos aumentó a 72,6 desde 70,3 en julio, lo que sugiere que la inflación podría mantenerse por sobre el objetivo del 2% del banco central estadounidense durante un tiempo. El presidente de la Fed, Kevin Warsh, dijo la semana pasada que el organismo "tendrá trabajo por delante" si los responsables monetarios no obtienen la confianza necesaria de que la inflación está descendiendo hacia el 2 %. Los mercados financieros descuentan una probabilidad de aproximadamente el 64% de que la Fed suba su tasa de interés de referencia a un día en 25 puntos básicos en su reunión de política monetaria del 15 al 16 de septiembre, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME Group. Dicha tasa se sitúa actualmente en el rango del 3,50%-3,75 por ciento. A pesar del repunte de los pedidos, el empleo en el sector de servicios se mantuvo moderado el mes pasado. El subíndice de empleo de la encuesta apenas varió, situándose en 47,8, lo que sugiere un posible riesgo a la baja para creación de empleo de agosto. Una encuesta de Reuters a economistas prevé que el Departamento de Trabajo anuncie este viernes que el empleo repuntó en 56.000 puestos de trabajo el mes pasado, tras un descenso inesperado de 23.000 en julio. Ese repunte reflejaría, en parte, una recuperación del empleo en el sector educativo de las administraciones locales. Sin embargo, algunos economistas se preparan para un segundo mes consecutivo de pérdidas de empleo tras la reciente finalización del Estatus de Protección Temporal para cientos de miles de haitianos, lo que afecta a su permiso de trabajo.

item.title: In rialzo dopo dichiarazioni Waller su mantenimento tassi Fed
item.description: Gli indici principali di Wall Street aprono in rialzo dopo che il governatore della Federal Reserve Christopher Waller ha detto che potrebbe sostenere il mantenimento dei tassi invariati questo mese, qualora i dati confermassero un rallentamento delle pressioni inflazionistiche.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Gli indici principali di Wall Street aprono in rialzo dopo che il governatore della Federal Reserve Christopher Waller ha detto che potrebbe sostenere il mantenimento dei tassi invariati questo mese, qualora i dati confermassero un rallentamento delle pressioni inflazionistiche. ** Queste dichiarazioni hanno spinto gli operatori a ridurre le aspettative di un rialzo dei tassi e potrebbero dissipare il clima di pessimismo sui mercati a seguito delle recenti tensioni militari tra Stati Uniti e Iran. ** "La mia decisione sull’orientamento appropriato della politica monetaria sarà fortemente influenzata dai dati sull’inflazione di agosto", ha affermato [USN:L6N44V0XX TEXT:"Waller"] durante un intervento all’evento Reuters NEXT Newsmaker tenutosi a Washington. ** "Se si registreranno progressi costanti verso il nostro obiettivo del 2%, sarò disposto a sostenere il mantenimento del tasso di riferimento al livello attuale", ha aggiunto Waller. ** Tuttavia, ha aggiunto, i costi di indebitamento potrebbero dover aumentare se i dati sull’inflazione indicassero il persistere delle pressioni sui prezzi. Secondo lo strumento CME FedWatch, gli operatori continuano a prevedere una probabilità di quasi il 48% di un rialzo dei tassi questo mese. ** Alle ore 16.20 italiane, l’indice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) sale di 394,74 punti, pari allo 0,74%, attestandosi a 53.456,69, l’S&P 500 (.SPX) guadagna 41,29 punti, pari allo 0,54%, attestandosi a 7.707,89, mentre il Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) guadagna 160,20 punti, pari allo 0,61%, attestandosi a 26.378,03. ** Broadcom (AVGO.O) cala del 5,26% dopo che le proprie previsioni sui ricavi del quarto trimestre si sono rivelate inferiori alle elevate aspettative di Wall Street, sottolineando come le aziende al centro dello sviluppo dell’intelligenza artificiale debbano superare una soglia molto alta.

item.title: BUZZ BORSA Lottomatica annulla calo post annuncio fusione Cirsa, vista opportunità ingresso
item.description: ** Lottomatica ha recuperato tutta la perdita di ieri, grazie alle ricoperture post annuncio della fusione con la spagnola Cirsa che aveva sorpreso il mercato. Positivo il giudizio dei broker, in particolare dopo le spiegazioni emerse nella call da parte del management, che hanno chiarito alcuni aspetti dell'operazione.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: ** Lottomatica (LTMC.MI) ha recuperato tutta la perdita di ieri, grazie alle ricoperture post annuncio della fusione con la spagnola Cirsa (CIRSA.MC) che aveva sorpreso il mercato. Positivo il giudizio dei broker, in particolare dopo le spiegazioni emerse nella call da parte del management, che hanno chiarito alcuni aspetti dell'operazione. ** Intorno alle 15,30 le azioni Lottomatica segnano un rialzo del 7% a 24,48 euro, mentre ieri avevano ceduto il 7,6%. Volumi intensi pari a 2,7 milioni a fronte di una media a 30 giorni per una intera seduta di 880 milioni. In denaro anche oggi Cirsa che balza di oltre il 7% alla borsa di Madrid. ** Secondo Equita, "la reazione del mercato ieri a nostro avviso è poco ragionevole e rappresenta un'opportunità: implica infatti una market cap combined post deal e riaggiungendo il dividendo pagato agli azionisti Cirsa praticamente uguale a quella delle due aziende pre-deal. Implica che il mercato non sta praticamente scontando alcun valore delle sinergie di costo generabili dal gruppo, che a nostro avviso sono credibili, solitamente prudenziali e che possono valere oltre 600 milioni di euro". ** Per il broker, in sostanza, il deal consente l’ingresso in un mercato più giovane e frammentato che può permettere a Lottomatica di sostenere i tassi di crescita del gruppo su un orizzonte più lungo. ** Anche Intermonte ritiene che l'operazione "sia accrescitiva, coerente dal punto di vista strategico e rafforzi ulteriormente l'investment case". ** In un'intervista a Il Sole-24 Ore l'AD, Gugliemo Angelozzi, ha spiegato che il calo di ieri è stato causato dagli arbitraggi di chi ha venduto allo scoperto i titoli della società acquirente per comprare quelli della società target, ma poi a prevalere saranno i fondamentali.

item.title: Crece resistencia a acuerdo entre Bolivia y FMI mientras diversos grupos se reúnen por crisis de combustible
item.description: La oposición al programa del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) para Bolivia de 1.900 millones de dólares está cobrando fuerza a medida que grupos cívicos, sindicatos y líderes empresariales relacionan cada vez más la escasez de combustible y los recortes a las subvenciones al diésel con las reformas que, en su opinión, están vinculadas al acuerdo de financiación.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La oposición al programa del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) para Bolivia de 1.900 millones de dólares está cobrando fuerza a medida que grupos cívicos, sindicatos y líderes empresariales relacionan cada vez más la escasez de combustible y los recortes a las subvenciones al diésel con las reformas que, en su opinión, están vinculadas al acuerdo de financiación. Representantes de nueve organizaciones cívicas y sociales se reunieron el miércoles en Cochabamba para pedir al Gobierno que alivie los costos, ya que la escasez de diésel y los recortes a los subsidios perjudican a los hogares y a la industria. La reunión aumenta la presión sobre el Gobierno del presidente centrista Rodrigo Paz, que busca el respaldo del Congreso para el [USN:L1N43V0VN TEXT:"acuerdo con el FMI"]. El acuerdo alcanzado el 29 de julio aún requiere la aprobación del Congreso y del Consejo Ejecutivo del FMI. El programa sería el primer acuerdo plurianual de Bolivia con el Fondo desde 2006 y podría desbloquear otros 5.000 millones de dólares en financiación de otros prestamistas multilaterales. En Santa Cruz, principal centro agrícola y empresarial de Bolivia, líderes cívicos han acusado al Gobierno de utilizar el acuerdo con el FMI para justificar los recortes en los subsidios al combustible antes de que el programa se haya aprobado. El Gobierno no ha revelado públicamente los detalles del paquete de financiamiento. "El Gobierno nacional nos tiene con el chantaje de que el FMI está pidiendo esto (la eliminación de los subsidios al combustible)", afirmó Agustín Zambrana, vicepresidente del Comité Pro Santa Cruz, que representa a grupos empresariales. "Que nos muestren la carta de intenciones con el FMI o que digan oficialmente cómo está esa negociación", añadió. El Gobierno de Paz ha tenido dificultades para disipar esa percepción después de que el ministro de la Presidencia, Fernando Aramayo, describiera la semana pasada una medida sobre el precio del diésel como una "condición" del FMI, antes de retractarse posteriormente de sus declaraciones. La escasez de combustible y el aumento de los precios ya han provocado este año protestas y cortes de carretera por parte de sindicatos, grupos indígenas y simpatizantes del expresidente de izquierda Evo Morales. La oposición al FMI está muy arraigada en Bolivia. Para muchas personas, el Fondo evoca recuerdos de austeridad y dificultades económicas de crisis pasadas, en las décadas de 1980 y 1990. Legisladores dijeron a Reuters que no existía en el Congreso ningún bloque organizado que se opusiera al acuerdo con el FMI. No obstante, analistas señalan que la creciente resistencia pública, especialmente por parte del sector empresarial, que en gran medida ha respaldado las reformas favorables al mercado de Paz, podría complicar los esfuerzos por conseguir apoyo si se requieren medidas impopulares adicionales. La tarea del Gobierno se ha visto dificultada por la salida, el 25 de agosto, del [USN:L1N44I0FC TEXT:"exministro de Economía"] José Gabriel Espinoza, quien lideró las negociaciones con el Fondo y fue obligado a dimitir. Un portavoz del FMI afirmó que el Fondo seguía colaborando con las autoridades bolivianas. REACCIÓN DE LOS MERCADOS La presión sobre la moneda boliviana también va en aumento. Según operadores, la incertidumbre sobre el calendario de la financiación externa ha incrementado la demanda de dólares, lo que ha provocado un debilitamiento del boliviano en los mercados paralelos durante las últimas semanas. Se espera que el primer desembolso del FMI se produzca a finales de agosto o principios de septiembre. Los inversores, que han visto cómo los precios de los bonos bolivianos se disparaban durante el último año ante la esperanza de que Paz pudiera dar un giro a la economía, están empezando a mostrarse de nuevo más cautelosos. Kathryn Exum, codirectora de Investigación Soberana en el fondo de cobertura Gramercy, especializado en mercados emergentes, dijo que las protestas y los cambios en el equipo económico apuntaban a un "reto más amplio de gobernabilidad" y que la cuestión clave es si conserva la influencia necesaria para impulsar los cambios que exige el programa del FMI. Katherine Renfrew, de Nuveen, que recientemente ha liquidado parte de las ganancias obtenidas en el mercado de bonos, se mostró de acuerdo y subrayó que no sería fácil. "Vemos retos por delante a la hora de aplicar las reducciones del déficit", dijo.

item.title: Ação da CSN dispara quase 20% após troca de CEO
item.description: As ações da CSN dispararam quase 20% nesta quinta-feira, após o grupo anunciar que Fabio Schvartsman será o novo presidente-executivo da companhia, substituindo Benjamin Steinbruch.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As ações da CSN (CSNA3.SA) dispararam quase 20% nesta quinta-feira, após o grupo anunciar que Fabio Schvartsman será o novo presidente-executivo da companhia, substituindo Benjamin Steinbruch. Steinbruch, que ocupava o cargo desde 2002 e é membro da família controladora do grupo, foi eleito presidente do conselho de administração. A mudança ocorre em um momento em que a CSN negocia a venda de um de seus principais ativos, a CSN Cimentos, e de participação em seus negócios em infraestrutura logística para reduzir dívida. Analistas do UBS BB avaliaram positivamente a nomeação de Schvartsman do ponto de vista de governança, "com a equipe de gestão da CSN passando agora a ser totalmente profissionalizada". Eles destacaram que o executivo é conhecido por conduzir processos de reestruturação e recuperação de empresas listadas em bolsa, com experiência na Klabin e na Vale (VALE3.SA) . Por volta de 10h40, os papéis avançavam cerca de 14%, a R$6,84, liderando as altas do Ibovespa (.BVSP) , que subia 1,5%. Na máxima, chegaram a R$7,17 (+19,9%). No ano, porém, ainda acumulam queda de 23,5%. De acordo com analistas do BTG Pactual, a mudança foi inesperada, mas representa uma notícia positiva. "Schvartsman é um executivo amplamente respeitado pelo mercado, com vasta experiência em empresas como Vale, Klabin e Ultrapar e, mais importante, entende o que precisa ser feito para reconstruir a confiança dos investidores e reposicionar a tese de investimento da CSN", afirmaram em relatório a clientes. Eles também destacaram que, além de potencialmente trazer um foco maior em desalavancagem, alocação de capital e venda de ativos, a mudança deve proporcionar mais clareza à estrutura de liderança da companhia e ao planejamento sucessório, "temas que fazem parte das discussões entre investidores há algum tempo". "Com Steinbruch permanecendo fortemente envolvido na empresa como presidente do conselho de administração, vemos a nova estrutura como uma evolução natural da liderança da CSN." A equipe do BTG ponderou, contudo, que a atratividade do investimento no médio prazo dependerá, em última instância, da capacidade de execução. Eles citaram que a alavancagem segue acima de 3 vezes, a queima de fluxo de caixa livre continua sendo uma realidade, e vendas relevantes de ativos, além da redução do endividamento, ainda são necessárias para fortalecer o balanço da empresa. "Ainda precisamos ver avanços concretos nessas frentes antes de adotar uma visão mais positiva ou revisar nossa recomendação neutra."

item.title: Commerzbank annuncia programma di buyback da 1,2 miliardi euro
item.description: Commerzbank , oggetto delle ambizioni di espansione di UniCredit , ha annunciato che avvierà un nuovo programma di riacquisto di azioni proprie per un importo massimo di 1,2 miliardi di euro al fine di aumentare la remunerazione degli azionisti.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) , oggetto delle ambizioni di espansione di UniCredit (CRDI.MI) , ha annunciato che avvierà un nuovo programma di riacquisto di azioni proprie per un importo massimo di 1,2 miliardi di euro al fine di aumentare la remunerazione degli azionisti. Commerzbank, che ha una capitalizzazione di mercato complessiva di circa 44 miliardi di euro, ha detto che il programma di buyback avrà inizio domani e proseguirà fino al 10 febbraio 2027, al più tardi. "Con questo prossimo programma di buyback, continuiamo ad attuare con coerenza la nostra attraente politica di restituzione del capitale", ha detto la Ceo Bettina Orlopp. Le azioni acquisite saranno annullate, come già avvenuto nei due precedenti programmi di riacquisto, ha aggiunto l’istituto di credito. La resistenza opposta dalla banca e dal governo tedesco ad un’acquisizione da parte di Unicredir si è indebolita da quando, a luglio, l’istituto di credito italiano ha raggiunto una partecipazione di quasi il 50%, sufficiente per influenzare l'esito delle assemblee degli azionisti, compresa la nomina dei membri del consiglio di amministrazione. Il ministro delle Finanze tedesco Lars Klingbeil ha in programma di incontrare l'AD di UniCredit Andrea Orcel, in base a quanto riferito da fonti a Reuters il mese scorso, a dimostrazione del coinvolgimento diretto di Berlino rispetto al tentativo della banca italiana di rilevare Commerz.

item.title: Vannacci a Cernobbio, per il leader di Futuro Nazionale test davanti a élite economica
